posts.title: An experiment with SIMD in Rust using fearless_simd
posts.description: SIMD is having a moment right now. Go added experimental SIMD support to their standard library. C++26 standardized std::simd (which hasn't been very well received ). Portable SIMD is available on nightly Rust via std::simd . The excellent fearless_simd cut a 1.0 release in September . It works on stable Rust. posts.title: A few assorted thoughts about LLMs in November 2026
posts.description: LLMs are useful tools. They're also the products of the greatest theft of intellectual labor in human history. Both of these things can be true at the same time. In the right hands, LLMs can produce good, reliable software in shorter timeframes than ever before. Most hands are not the right hands.
